final_claim.narrative: A time-respecting route from 1800 to 1115 exists in the interval when no max-wait is enforced (step_02), but the inter-event waits on that route are 4788, 4699, and 3010 — all far above the 600-unit threshold. A reachability query that enforces the 600 max-wait returns no route (step_01). Therefore a cascade meeting the ≤600 inter-event waiting requirement is absent.
